temporal: half-open validity intersection; absent start/end is unknown/open; created/observed/recorded/updated time cannot exceed query as_of
cardinality: All declared singleton edges are primary. Concurrent overlapping assignments are refused; nonoverlapping history retained. Other relationship types are not universally singleton or acyclic. MAINTAINED_BY unaccepted claims and VERIFIED responsibility occupy separate tiers (DEC-067); both retain exclusive temporal cardinality within their tier.
write_boundary: Trusted domain services only; auth, approval binding, state transitions and durable event delivery are later gates, not supplied by these low-level repositories.

schedule_cardinality.effective_interval: intersection of relationship and target ServiceSchedule half-open validity
schedule_cardinality.overlap: reject within route/service; different service types and nonoverlapping applicability allowed
schedule_cardinality.schedule_spec: opaque; no inferred recurrence compatibility or alias normalization; same-service recurring windows belong in one definition
schedule_cardinality.node_updates: revalidate affected incoming assignments on service_type/valid_from/valid_to updates

test_graph_targets.authorization: internal target guard, not database RBAC

hop_semantics.max_hops: total path edges, including connectors; default6, hard cap6
hop_semantics.infrastructure_hops: DRAINS_TO edges only; derived as effective total minus fixed connectors
hop_semantics.search_limited: true for variable-length families or omitted fixed branches; empty result is only a bounded negative
hop_semantics.truncated: result row/node/edge cap reached; independent of hop/search bounds

ownership_cardinality.verified: One nonoverlapping reviewed responsibility interval per asset, independent of retained candidate claims
ownership_cardinality.unverified: Candidate/reported claims retain existing exclusivity within their claim tier
ownership_cardinality.candidate_promotion: Never automatic; acquisition adds immutable sourced records
